name: Humisense API
tagline: A voice and language layer for your own product
description: An integration layer that lets a website or application accept spoken input and respond with speech. You keep your interface and your data; the API handles transcription, intent routing and synthesis.
features: Intent routing to your own endpoints
Server-side key handling so credentials never reach the browser
benefits: Adds a voice interface without rebuilding your front end
Keeps your existing backend as the source of truth
Fits inside your own access controls

use_cases.title: Support sites
use_cases.description: Spoken questions routed to the same knowledge base that serves written answers.

use_cases.title: Internal tools
use_cases.description: Hands-free data entry for staff working away from a keyboard.

use_cases.title: Field applications
use_cases.description: Voice capture in environments where typing is impractical.

api_example.code:
import requests

response = requests.post(
    'https://api.humisense.com/v1/speech/transcribe',
    headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer <your-server-side-key>'},
    files={'audio': open('clip.wav', 'rb')},
    data={'language': 'en'}
)
print(response.json()['text'])

pricing: Pricing is agreed per engagement. This API is in prototype and is not sold as a self-serve subscription.
